source.verification: Recorded interpretation. Original private evidence is unavailable to other consumers; this summary is not independent verification.

text: Focused behavior evidence: `MailGlue` has ordered observer-based startup/shutdown cleanup; `CalCalendarManager` owns provider registration, cached calendars, timers, and teardown; `CalCachedCalendar` completes remote work before cache changes and guards duplicate completion; `saveCalendarEventCreate` uses Redux request IDs/baselines to reject stale results; Firefox starts via `nsBrowserApp.cpp` and `XRE_main*`; `GetServiceLocked` releases its monitor around user code. [Task 1]
title: Thunderbird and Firefox source-ingestion evidence and publication
